definition: the place where two bones meet
description: A museum hall with a glass roof, marble floor and white arches during a thunderstorm, lightning flashing above. A young woman in an orange climbing helmet with a head torch, a grey T-shirt and a harness stands on metal scaffolding and guides the huge ball-shaped end of a giant fossil bone into its round socket, forming the joint of a dinosaur leg hanging from a crane hook. Below, workers in hard hats raise their arms and cheer between wooden crates of bones, and a man drives a small yellow crane.
